items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Jab Stone used to run it. A fellow called Jab Stone.

ctx.x: Do you remember the name of the nightclub?
No. We call it Backbiters Club. Jab Stone used to run it. A fellow called Jab Stone. He used to wear a twenty-dollar goldpiece on his watchchain.
That sounds like a line from a blues I've heard.
